login: Enter the demo front-desk email and password.
Sign in and confirm that the clinic overview appears.
Confirm that the transition after login does not perform a full-page reload.
book-consultation: Open the doctor directory and wait for all eight doctors to appear.
Choose any doctor and start a consultation booking.
Enter a patient name, age 35, and a valid phone number.
Choose Consultation, continue, and select a future appointment time.
Review the doctor fee, GST, and total, then confirm the booking.
Verify that an appointment-confirmed message appears and the new patient is in the appointment schedule.
age-validation: Start a consultation booking for any doctor.
Enter age 150 with otherwise valid patient details.
Choose Consultation, continue, and attempt to confirm the future time.
Verify that age 150 is rejected and no appointment is confirmed.
emergency-fee-zero: Start a booking and enter valid patient details.
Choose Emergency as the visit type and continue.
Select a future time and review the fee breakdown.
Verify that both the doctor fee and total are zero before confirming.
invoice-total-correct: Read every amount in the invoice line items.
Add the line-item amounts and compare the exact result with the displayed total.
cancel-appointment: Open Appointments and scroll well down the virtualized schedule to Rahul Iyer.
Start cancellation for Rahul Iyer’s appointment.
Verify that no row is removed before explicit confirmation.
Confirm the cancellation and verify that Rahul Iyer’s row is gone.
reschedule-appointment: Open Appointments and locate an existing confirmed visit.
Start rescheduling that appointment from the available appointment actions.
Choose a different future time and confirm the change.
Verify that the appointment remains present and displays the new time.
toggle-sms-reminders: Locate the SMS reminders preference and its custom switch.
Change the switch and verify that the preference is saved.
Reload and confirm that the new preference remains active.
doctor-list-loads: Open the doctor directory from clinic navigation.
Verify that a loading state is shown instead of the complete directory immediately.
Wait for loading to finish and verify that all eight doctor cards appear.
